regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of the 21st, just noted. I am so glad to know that your dear little one is improving. I surely hope she continues so - and surpriz the doctors. I am you and your husband in the Masses as the herewith cards indicate. You should each make a proposition to the good God in your own best way, to do something in Thanksgiving if the. baby is spared. I think I told you something to that effect last week. In the mean time we'll keep on praying and trusing in the Good God to see fit and best to spare the little one. God bless you all - and breathe a little for the conversion of this poor sinner Solanus who makes so little progress in faith, hope and charity.
